page-structure.evidence: Title 'Amazon.com: Keep shopping for' is non-descriptive — omits what category is being shopped for (2.4.2 A). Multiple H1s used for section labels ('Price ($)', 'Customer reviews', 'Related items to consider', 'Best Sellers', 'Customers also bought') — these are filter/widget headings, not page-level headings, creating a broken hierarchy (1.3.1 A). H2→H4 skip occurs (collect heading-order axe hit). DIV/al6 headings used in footer ('Get to Know Us', etc.) with aria-level=6 after H5s — minor but flagged by axe. No <main> or role=main landmark present (1.3.1 A — no main landmark). Hidden H2s 'Skip to' and 'Keyboard shortcuts' appear in the tree before the visible H1.
